explanations.5: Escalation is idempotent within each SLA cycle. Repeated scans must produce at most one escalation event until a reopen starts a new cycle.
explanations.8: eval() executes arbitrary code and introduces security vulnerabilities; json.loads with schema validation is the safe approach.
